mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) may inhibit colchicine metabolism via CYP3A4, increasing colchicine levels and toxicity risk; additive CNS effects and potential sympathomimetic interactions if colchicine taken with tyramine-containing foods.
action: Monitor for colchicine toxicity (GI symptoms, myopathy); consider dose reduction of colchicine; counsel patient on tyramine-restricted diet compliance with phenelzine.
